visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair and bangs, wearing an oatmeal-colored hoodie, sits behind a wooden table in a living room setting. She holds a red cherry tomato between her fingers and speaks directly to the camera with a bright, energetic expression. On the table before her are two bowls: one contains clear water with floating ice cubes, and the other holds a mix of red cherry tomatoes and dark purple grapes. Behind her, a grey couch is visible with a pink bunny plush and a light box displaying 'KIKI EAT'. Yellow text overlays with black borders are at the top. (2) The camera shifts to a close-up angle looking down into the bowl of ice water. The woman's hands enter the frame, picking up individual grapes and cherry tomatoes from the dry bowl and dropping them into the icy water. The water splashes slightly as each fruit is submerged. A yellow banner remains at the top of the frame. (3) Returning to the medium shot, the woman uses a silver spoon to stir the fruit in the ice water bowl vigorously. She smiles at the camera, her movements indicating a sense of anticipation. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the fruit and the glossy ice. (4) The woman uses her hands to pick up a dark grape from the ice water. She holds it close to the lens to show a thin, translucent layer of ice that has formed on its surface. Her eyes are wide with excitement. (5) She puts a frozen grape into her mouth and bites down. Immediately, her expression changes to one of extreme cold; she winces, squints her eyes, and begins to cough into her fist while laughing. The background remains the same studio-like home environment. (6) She continues to talk to the camera, gesturing with her hands to describe the experience. She occasionally reaches back into the bowl to pick up more fruit. Her facial expressions are animated and humorous as she shares her reaction. (7) A close-up shows her holding two cherry tomatoes, one of which appears to have a thicker crust of ice. She brings one to her mouth and takes a large bite, showing the cross-section to the camera. (8) In the final segment, she sits back and provides a summary, still holding a tomato. She maintains high energy, smiling and nodding as she concludes the video. The lighting remains bright studio-style throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative food hack tutorial and reaction vlog. The creator demonstrates a unique method of making a 'low-sugar' version of candied fruit (Tanghulu) by using ice water to create a frozen shell. The core appeal lies in the creator's energetic personality and the humorous, authentic reaction to how cold the result is.
